versions.changelog:
Self-improving agent v2.0.0 introduces a memory-based self-improvement system for AI, enabling learning from mistakes and continuous optimization.

- Implements a structured memory system to automatically record errors, user corrections, best practices, and knowledge gaps.
- Enforces mandatory memory checks before actions (code generation, command execution, recommendations) to avoid repeated mistakes and respect user preferences.
- Captures and prioritizes user corrections, documented errors, optimized practices, and knowledge updates with specific logging routines.
- Provides guidelines for systematic retrieval, conflict resolution, periodic memory maintenance, and cross-project syncing.
- Includes clear templates for transparent communication when applying learned experiences or updating knowledge.
